content.short: A collection with 3000 unique pixel art whales with unique super rare custom pieces included.
content.description:
ADAWHALES is a mission-driven project that will contribute to charitable causes that are working to protect the whales of the oceans. By owning ADAWHALES CNFTs you a will help your fellows from the oceans as a part of the sales will be allocated to causes that benefits them. We are working to bring you high quality pixel ADAWHALES and we are expecting to launch in JAN-FEB 2022.

The collection will consist of 3000 unique whales designed manually and assembled with genetative code, with a limited number of super rare custom pieces included . Revenues will be stacked for continuous rewards used as donations towards responding charities.
